title: Significant Breakthrough in Domestic Computing Power Ecosystem: Moar Thread Rapidly Adapts to MiniMax H3 Multimodal Large Model

content_html:
On August 3, MiniMax officially open-sourced its first multimodal generation model, MiniMax H3. On the day the news was announced, MoLeThread quickly completed the rapid adaptation and efficient operation of the model by leveraging its AI training and inference integrated smart computing card MTT S5000 and MUSA software stack.

As a new masterpiece from MiniMax in the field of multimodal, H3 breaks the traditional single-task boundaries, accurately understands the creative intention in diverse contexts, and comprehensively supports comprehensive input of text, images, audio, and video. According to the official introduction, the model can directly output native audio-visual content with a resolution of 2K and a maximum length of 15 seconds, possessing commercial-grade multi-scenario generation capabilities in terms of performance and practicality.

Notably, H3 achieved the top global score for "video editing capability" in the Artificial Analysis video model ranking. The cost of generating 2K resolution video is as low as 0.8 yuan per second, offering high commercial cost-effectiveness. Meanwhile, its open-source nature significantly lowers the application barrier, supporting flexible local deployment and custom data for enterprises, effectively meeting security and compliance requirements, and accelerating the widespread adoption of multimodal productivity.

Facing the new release of the model, the MoLeThread team demonstrated an extremely high response efficiency. On the day the model was open-sourced, its R&D team quickly conducted model architecture analysis, core technology investigation, and typical operator sorting, completing the full adaptation path from the SGLang-MUSA inference framework to the MATE and muDNN high-performance operator libraries within just 3 hours, achieving fast deployment and stable operation of H3 on the MTT S5000.

MoLeThread stated that it will continue to deepen cooperation with MiniMax in the future, jointly exploring stronger context understanding capabilities and larger model scales in the multimodal field, and fully accelerating the innovation and industrialization of AGI technology.

content_html_zh:
8月3日，MiniMax正式开源旗下首款多模式代车型MiniMax H3。 消息公布当天，MoLeThread凭借其AI训练推理一体智能计算卡MTT S5000和MUSA软件栈，快速完成了模型的快速适配和高效运行。

作为MiniMax在多模态领域的全新力作，H3打破了传统的单任务边界，准确理解多元情境下的创作意图，全面支持文本、图像、音频、视频的综合输入。 据官方介绍，该机型可直接输出分辨率为2K、最长时长为15秒的原生视听内容，在性能和实用性上具备商用级多场景生成能力。

值得注意的是，H3在人工分析视频模型排名中，“视频编辑能力”得分全球第一。 生成2K分辨率视频的成本低至0.8元/秒，商业性价比极高。 同时，其开源特性大大降低了应用门槛，支持企业灵活的本地部署和自定义数据，有效满足安全和合规要求，加速多模式生产力的广泛采用。

面对新的模型发布，MoLeThread团队表现出了极高的响应效率。 模型开源当天，研发团队快速进行模型架构分析、核心技术调研和典型算子梳理，仅用3小时就完成了从SGLang-MUSA推理框架到MATE和muDNN高性能算子库的全程适配路径，实现了H3在MTT S5000上的快速部署和稳定运行。

MoLeThread表示，未来将继续深化与MiniMax的合作，共同探索多模态领域更强的上下文理解能力和更大的模型规模，全面加速AGI技术的创新和产业化。
